releaseHint: Review the production pointer, rollout traffic, monitoring and audit trail. Rollback changes configuration only.
noReleases: No releases yet. Validate and approve a plan in "Improvement plans"; approved plans appear under "Approved capabilities" below, then click "Prepare release".
title: Agent evaluation
intro: Prepare business questions, review answers in batches, and find areas to improve.
capability: Batch answers, retrieval metrics and optional Judge scoring.
datasetDialogHint: Name the dataset first, then add real business questions and reference answers. You can start an evaluation after saving.
empty: No dataset yet. Enter business questions or download and import the template.
historyHint: Review progress, retrieval scores, and per-question results for each run.
noRuns: No evaluations yet. Prepare questions to get started.
name: Dataset name
manualHint: Start with 3–5 questions and reference answers. This collects agent answers for review; it does not automatically judge answer correctness.
question: Question
fileHint: JSON or CSV, up to 5MB and 1000 cases. Each case needs question and ground_truth. JSON is a top-level array; CSV uses a header row. Optional: relevant_doc_ids (for retrieval scores); expected_tools, the tool names or IDs expected in order ([] means no tool call); expected_branch, the expected branch name or ID; history, earlier user messages sent in the same chat (multi-turn, up to 20). In CSV, array fields are JSON array strings.
published: Publish the agent before evaluation. Unpublished edits are excluded; publish again after changing its configuration.
runHint: Questions run in the background. Duration depends on question count and response time. Only one evaluation can run per agent at a time.
scoreHint: Retrieval scores measure retrieval of labeled documents, not answer accuracy. Missing document labels produce no score; answers can still be reviewed against references.
waiting: No question results yet. Running evaluations update as questions complete.
expandHint: Expand each row to compare the agent answer, reference answer, and metrics.
oneFile: Remove the selected file before choosing another.
sampleQuestion: How do I request a refund?
sampleAnswer: Replace this with the correct, complete refund process for your business.
questionRequired: Enter a question and reference answer for every item.
fileRequired: Choose a JSON or CSV file.
saved: Dataset saved. Confirm the evaluation settings.
started: Evaluation submitted. Results will update automatically.
downloadFailed: Could not download the report. Check that the evaluation has generated a report and try again.
experimentInvalid: Enter a name, unique keys and percentages totaling 100%.
experimentHint: Callers must attach experiment assignments to conversations. Agent settings are not switched automatically.
sampleHint: Sample up to 50 recent conversation events not yet sampled. Open details to inspect rule metrics and evidence, annotate, or resolve a Badcase.
noNewBadcases: No new badcases. Review or evaluate samples first.
idsHint: One ID per line or comma separated
embeddingRequired: Choose an embedding model when Judge is enabled.
baselineRequired: Choose a baseline for regression evaluation.
judgeMode: Scoring: retrieval metrics + Judge answer quality
deleteConfirm: Delete this evaluation dataset? Datasets with existing runs cannot be deleted.
datasetDetailHint: Review questions, reference answers and related document labels.
onlineQualityHint: Track stability, efficiency and resolution in real conversations.
experimentsHint: Manage traffic splits for prompt or model variants.
samplesHint: Review real conversations and turn findings into quality signals.
badcasesHint: Resolve low-quality answers and track improvement to closure.
businessBranchHint: Business branches require actual tool results to confirm an operation.
replayHint: Use saved questions and application version with current knowledge, skills and tools.
replayUnavailable: This run has no question or application version snapshot. Create a new evaluation.
replayConfirm: Create a run using the original questions and application version? Current knowledge, skills and tools may make real calls and produce different results.
citationUnavailable: Citation identifiers were not captured. Retrieval hits do not prove citation use.
traceLoadError: Failed to load evidence. Please retry.
historicalNodeEvidence: Node evidence comes from the original chat record; this historical sample has no node snapshot.
judgeModelHint: Scores correctness, faithfulness and citation relevance. Requires an Embedding model. Judge scores are separate from the retrieval score.
noExperiments: No experiments yet. Create one to configure traffic groups.
noSamples: No review samples yet. Sample real conversations to begin.
noBadcases: No badcases yet. Annotate or evaluate samples to generate them.
tasksHelp: Tasks are defined by datasets with questions, reference answers and optional document annotations. Saved tasks can run repeatedly.
executionsHelp: Track progress and errors, inspect case results, or rerun from a saved snapshot.
reportsHelp: Statistical analysis of a single finished run: score distribution, issue breakdown, metric means, response time and category scores. Export as Markdown, JSON or CSV.
compareHelp: Select two reports with the same dataset content version. Delta is second minus first, in percentage points for scores. Scoring coverage may differ.
noReports: Reports appear after an evaluation finishes.
ruleGradingHelp: Retrieval metrics require relevant document IDs. Judge is optional and independent; rule results do not currently gate Judge execution.
overviewHelp: Counts cover currently loaded samples and Badcases, not all historical data. Categories can overlap. Click a count to open its queue.
queueHelp: Samples and Badcases are merged by sample ID. Processed means archived, Badcase resolved/ignored, or an annotation exists. The current API does not distinguish preannotations from human annotations; verify in details. Low scores come from annotations, not Judge.
signalsHelp: Aggregated conversation signals. Feedback-based resolution and single-turn resolution are proxies inferred from feedback, not verified business outcomes.
ruleSignalHelp: Flags available retrieval hit, recall, citation ID, confirmation, task success or tool accuracy results below 60%. These are signals, not final failure decisions; missing data is not classified.
rulePassRateHelp: Share of scored questions with a retrieval score of at least 60% and no execution error. Questions without labelled relevant documents are excluded.
noLowCases: No low-score, unscored or failed questions
qcGuideTitle: How to use the quality center
qcStepCollectDesc: Pull recent live conversations; rule checks run automatically
qcStepReviewDesc: Check each answer and pick a problem category if it is wrong
qcStepImproveDesc: Fix where the diagnosis points: tool, model, retrieval or prompt
qcGenerateHint: Scans sampled chats: dislikes, human handoffs, no retrieval hits, responses over 10 s and samples given a problem category become badcases.
qcQueueStart: No samples yet. Click "Sample live chats" to pull 50 recent conversations for review.
qcNext_review: Next: click "Human review" and judge whether the answer is correct. Pick a problem category if not.
qcNext_rule: Rule checks flagged this sample (e.g. no relevant document hit). Review it to confirm.
qcNext_low: Low human score. To fix it, pick a problem category and then click "Generate badcases".
qcNext_badcase: Confirmed problem. Use the diagnosis below to fix it; for bigger changes create an improvement plan and validate offline; mark it resolved once fixed.
qcRecheckHint: Recompute retrieval hit, citation and faithfulness signals with deterministic rules
qcCategoryHint: Picking a category marks this sample as a badcase. After saving, click "Generate badcases" to add it to the list.
qcImproveWhenDesc: For riskier changes (prompts, skills, knowledge tasks) that you want to replay offline against a finished evaluation run before releasing. Sources can be report findings or live badcases. For simple fixes, just follow the diagnosis.
qcSignalsDesc: Watch overall live trends. When something looks off, sample conversations in "To do".
qcSourceOnline: This page handles problems found in live conversations. For problems found by test datasets (offline evaluation), fix them from the evaluation report.
diagHelp: Uses each result's execution evidence (node status and errors, retrieved paragraphs, scores) to locate the problem and link to where to fix it. It is an evidence-based inference; confirm it yourself.
diagNone: No clear problem found in the evidence
diagNoneRun: No questions in this run need fixing
fix_tool: Fix the tool: check its code, parameter mapping and whether the external API is available.
fix_model: Fix the model: check availability and timeouts; switch model or tune parameters if needed.
fix_retrieval: Fix retrieval: check the knowledge base has this content, then tune the search node threshold, top-k or search mode.
fix_prompt: Fix the prompt: the retrieved content is right but the answer misuses it; edit the AI node system prompt or prompt.
fix_unknown: Not enough evidence; open the execution trace and check manually.
diagRunError: Execution failed but no specific node was identified
diagMissedDocs: Retrieved {count} paragraphs, none from the labelled relevant documents
diagUnfaithful: Retrieval was fine but the answer is not grounded in it (faithfulness {value})
diagWrongAnswer: Retrieval was fine but the answer does not match the reference (correctness {value})
diagNoEvidence: The answer was judged wrong but the evidence shows no anomaly; check manually
rerunAfterFixHint: After your change, run the same questions again and confirm in the new report
judgePromptHelp: Write only the scoring criteria here: adjust how each dimension is scored or add business rules. The output format (four score fields + reason) and the data to evaluate are appended automatically, so editing this cannot break the scores. The prompt is saved in this run's snapshot and reused on re-run.
judgePromptLegacy: This run predates configurable prompts and used the built-in prompt of that time
judgeDefaultsHelp: Save defaults for new evaluations of this application. Each run snapshots its parameters; replay uses the original settings.
judgeThinking_auto: Auto (disable for Bailian / Qwen; otherwise provider default)
judgeSettingsHelp: Recommended: temperature 0, 4096 tokens, auto reasoning. JSON mode and explicit reasoning controls require provider support. Disable JSON mode and select auto if parameters are rejected. Increase tokens or disable reasoning when output is truncated.
retrievalSettingsHelp: Shows the latest published version. Edit retrieval in application settings or workflow nodes, publish, then start a new evaluation. Check branch execution, knowledge bindings, embedding status, search mode, similarity threshold, result count and reranking. Test failed queries in the knowledge base.
fallbackHelp: Workflow fallbacks use conditions and downstream reply or model nodes. Check empty-result connections and responses. Exception handling is separate from empty-result fallback. A fallback response does not improve retrieval hit rate.
diagSearchSkipped: No retrieval execution observed after intent routing ({node})
fixSearchSkipped: Check intent classification and branch connections. Product questions may route to a static reply. Route knowledge questions through retrieval and configure an empty-result fallback. Lowering similarity thresholds cannot fix skipped retrieval.
diagWrongBranch: Wrong branch: "{node}" did not take the expected branch "{expected}"
diagToolOrder: All expected tools were called, but in a different order
zeroHelp: Retrieval metrics are only computed for cases with relevant_doc_ids. A 0 means no retrieved paragraph came from a labeled document; each cause has a different fix.
zeroFix_skipped: Intent routing sent the question to a branch without retrieval. Fix the intent branch descriptions or add retrieval to that branch.
zeroFix_empty: Lower the similarity threshold, raise top_n, or confirm the knowledge base covers this content.
zeroFix_mismatch: Compare labeled vs retrieved in the diagnosis below. If the retrieved document is also correct, extend the label; otherwise tune retrieval or chunking.
zeroFix_stale: The labeled IDs were deleted, re-imported with new IDs, or belong to a knowledge base the app does not use. Update relevant_doc_ids.
zeroUnlabeled: {count} more cases have no relevant_doc_ids, so retrieval is not scored for them (not 0).
diagStaleLabel: {count} labeled documents are stale, so the retrieval score is meaningless
fixStaleLabel: Find the current document IDs in the knowledge base, update relevant_doc_ids, and rerun.
labelInvalid: {count} of {total} labeled cases have stale relevant_doc_ids and will score 0 on retrieval
labelStatus_outside: not in the app knowledge bases
